nameLocal: 有限责任公司 (limited liability company; foreign-owned: WFOE)
disclaimer: Not legal or tax advice. Check with an accountant or lawyer.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国公司法 (Company Law, revised 2023, in force 1 July 2024)
企业信息公示暂行条例 (Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure, 2024 revision)
企业所得税汇算清缴管理办法 (rules for the annual corporate income tax settlement)

conditions.label: Foreign-invested
conditions.description: Owned in whole or in part by foreign investors (for example a WFOE).

conditions.label: General VAT taxpayer
conditions.description: Files VAT as a general taxpayer.

profileFields.label: Unified social credit code (统一社会信用代码)
profileFields.description: The 18-character code on the business licence.

profileFields.label: Registered capital (注册资本)
profileFields.description: The capital subscribed by all shareholders, in yuan.

profileFields.label: Capital contribution deadline
profileFields.description: The date in the articles by which the subscribed capital is paid in (at most five years from incorporation).

roles.label: Legal representative (法定代表人)
roles.description: Registered as the company's legal representative.

roles.label: Director (董事)
roles.description: Sits on the board, or is the sole director.

setupSteps.title: Draft the articles of association
setupSteps.description: The articles set the shareholders, their subscribed capital and the contribution deadline.

setupSteps.title: Get any approval the business needs first
setupSteps.description: Where laws or regulations require approval before registration, obtain it first.

setupSteps.title: Apply for establishment registration
setupSteps.description: Apply to the company registration authority with the application and the articles. The business licence's date of issue is the date the company is formed.
setupSteps.authority: Market regulation administration (市场监督管理局)

setupSteps.title: Set up the tax account and invoicing
setupSteps.description: Complete the tax information and invoicing set-up with the local tax bureau.

setupSteps.title: Open the basic bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks ask for the business licence.

setupSteps.title: File the foreign investment information report
setupSteps.description: Foreign-invested companies report investment information. Check the current procedure.

obligations.title: Pay in the subscribed capital
obligations.description: Shareholders pay their subscribed capital as the articles say, within five years of incorporation. Set the date under Capital in Profile.

obligations.title: Annual report on the enterprise credit system
obligations.description: Between 1 January and 30 June, report the previous year's information through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System. Companies formed this year start next year.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax prepayment
obligations.description: File and pay within 15 days after each month or quarter ends (including the fourth quarter). The dates shown assume quarterly prepayment.

obligations.title: Annual corporate income tax settlement
obligations.description: Within five months after the tax year ends (31 May for a calendar year).

obligations.title: VAT and surcharge returns
obligations.description: Usually monthly or quarterly. Check the period and the date with the local tax bureau.

obligations.title: Register changes
obligations.description: Changes to registered matters (name, domicile, capital, business scope, legal representative, shareholders) are registered with the registration authority.
